opening.label: Flat to marginally mixed start
opening.headline: Flat to marginally mixed start: Wall Street weak, Asia negative, crude easing
drivers: GIFT Nifty 25,752.5 (-48 pts, -0.19% vs Nifty's last close).
Asia this morning: Nikkei -5.06%, Hang Seng -1.89%, Kospi -5.21%.
Currency, crude and volatility: Brent 87.89 (-4.45%); USD/INR 92.690 (-0.83%); India VIX 17.32 (+7.51%).

story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,368, a gap-down of 0.57% from the previous close of 25,514.
The index dipped to a low of 25,354 (-0.63%) around 9:15 AM and touched a high of 25,809 (+1.15%) around 3:05 PM.
It settled at 25,801 (+1.12%), near the top of the day's range, so buyers held control into the close.
33 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 16 declined; Bank Nifty outperformed (+2.49%).
Latest institutional data (18 Nov): FII/FPI net +5867 Cr, DII net -3160 Cr.
risks: Markets stay shut until Monday (3 days): weekend news, geopolitics and any Wall Street or Asian moves will all be priced in at the open.
Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,175.83 (-2.02%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$87.89 (-4.45%); a sharp fall would help oil marketers and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 92.690 (-0.83%), US 10-year yield 5.05% (-0.28%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 25,752.5 (-0.19% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
